sources.title: NVIDIA Releases NemotronLabs VoiceChat 11B: An Open Full-Duplex Speech ...
sources.snippet: NVIDIA has released NemotronLabs VoiceChat 11B, an open 11B end-to-end speech-to-speech model for real-time, full-duplex conversation. Instead of chaining ASR, an LLM, and TTS, it performs streaming speech understanding and speech generation in one unified network.
